title: AI Car Inspection SaaS Dashboard
palette_note: Grain-flecked near-white UI floated on pure black; effectively zero chroma except a single acid-lime #CCFC00 that appears only on 3px progress fills.

type.note: One light-weight display line ('Purchase Inspection') at roughly 5x the body size over uniformly 9–10px micro-labels; almost no bold anywhere, so hierarchy is carried entirely by scale and by solid black pills.

imagery: cut-out studio product photography (car) plus a photographic laptop mockup

layout.note: Two-column split with a floating right rail; every container is fully rounded and every control is a pill or a filled black circle. No rules or borders at all — separation comes from a 1-step tone shift plus a wide soft shadow.

style_signature: Paper-grain off-white cards with pill-everything geometry, solid black circular controls and one acid-lime hairline highlight, all shot as a laptop render on a black set.

title: Finance SaaS Website
palette_note: Charcoal letterbox framing a desaturated moss-sage photographic field; white is the only interface colour, with a lone emerald #20D080 progress bar and a mustard sibling as the sole saturated notes.

type.note: Signature move is a two-line hero that swaps face mid-sentence: line one in a wide low-contrast sans, line two in a high-contrast italic didone serif at the same optical size. A tracked ALL-CAPS eyebrow sits above; the same italic serif recurs at 12px on card titles.

imagery: 3D/macro organic renders — moss, lichen and a chrome-and-moss ribbon — bled edge to edge

layout.note: Centred single-column hero inside an inset dark frame with visible page margin; the product shot is a cluster of overlapping translucent cards tilted off the centre axis, with body copy pushed to the bottom-left corner rather than the centre.

style_signature: Full-bleed desaturated moss-green macro nature imagery inside a charcoal frame, with a sans/italic-didone hero pairing and small frosted-glass cards as the only UI.

title: Sugar CRM - SaaS Dashboard & UX UI Design
palette_note: Periwinkle-tinted whites over a flat mid-grey studio backdrop; there is no brand hue at all — solid black pills do the accenting, and charting is limited to dusty #80A0D0 blue and #C06070 clay.

type.note: Bold 40px page title against regular 15px card labels; no caps, no tracking tricks, no display face — type stays deliberately quiet so the extruded surfaces read first.

imagery: cut-out portrait photography (avatars) plus line iconography

layout.note: Browser-chrome mockup over a kanban of pill-shaped rows in four columns; every element is embossed off the surface by a soft light-from-top-left shadow with a matching light rim — nothing has an edge, only a raised lip.

style_signature: Full neumorphism at scale — pillowy pill-shaped cards embossed out of a periwinkle-white gradient with paired light/dark shadows and zero borders, accented only by solid black pills.

title: Table Accordion for Investor Dashboard Saas
palette_note: Cool white with a faint blue-violet cast; a deep teal #008090 owns the single primary action, while amber-to-orange score donuts and red/green delta text carry every other piece of meaning.

type.note: Inter-class UI face with tabular figures doing the heavy lifting — numeric values set semibold against regular labels, and tiny tracked ALL-CAPS 'SCORE' micro-labels in the left rail. No display type whatsoever.

imagery: iconography only, plus a single company logo mark

layout.note: Zoomed-in crop that bleeds off all four edges so the app reads as a fragment; strict year-column grid; the expanded accordion row drops into a sub-grid of stat blocks divided by 3px coloured left rules and thin vertical hairlines.

style_signature: Hairline-ruled white data table cropped hard off-canvas, with semibold tabular figures, red/green delta pairs, thin arc score donuts and exactly one saturated teal action button.

title: Aoscan – AI-Powered SaaS HR Recruitment Dashboard
palette_note: Cool blue-grey stage behind pure-white cards; a single electric royal #1854F0 marks the active bar, primary button and links, with everything else neutral apart from iridescent pink-violet-blue gradient patches.

type.note: Inter-class face at a small base size; the only scale jump is the metric numerals (21,230 / 70%) at roughly 3x body. Emphasis inside sentences is done by weight change on individual words rather than colour.

imagery: cut-out portrait photography in avatars plus abstract blurred gradient blobs

layout.note: Double left rail (icon strip plus nav list) with a three-column card grid; cards are equal-height, hairline-bordered, ~12px radius, generously padded, and the whole app sits as an inset panel with visible stage margin.

style_signature: Hairline-bordered white cards on a cool grey-blue stage with one electric royal-blue accent, softened by iridescent pink-violet gradient-mesh patches used as the AI signifier.

title: RecruitTrack - AI Recruit Management SaaS
palette_note: Warm-neutral cast-concrete studio grey around a pure-white app; colour arrives only as two chalky pastel blocks — pistachio #D8E4C0 card and lilac #E4D8F0 tab bar — plus one red notification dot.

type.note: Stacked two-line headline in a rounded geometric with tight leading; percentages set large with a raised small superscript % glyph; supporting labels drop to a light grade at half the size.

imagery: photographic set — a phone against a cast-concrete slab — with cut-out avatar portraits inside the UI

layout.note: One dominant card per screen with lots of white above it; horizontally scrolling pill filter chips that run off the right edge; a filled black circular FAB and a floating pill tab bar. Everything is fully rounded — no square corner exists.

style_signature: White mobile UI where the only colour is one chalky pastel colour-block card and a lilac floating pill tab bar, punctuated by solid black circular buttons and shot on a raw concrete set.

title: RentEase Mobile App - Property Management SaaS
palette_note: Flat cyclorama grey and white with a cool sage-grey data card; a single highlighter #FCFC6C yellow does all of the chart work, and lilac #C0C0E4 is reserved for the tab bar.

type.note: Same rounded geometric as its sibling shot — stacked two-line title with tight leading, medium-weight card headings, and light small-caps-sized month labels under the chart.

imagery: 3D phone render on a seamless backdrop; iconography only inside the app

layout.note: Single scrolling column: title, overflowing pill filter row, then one tall data card, with a floating pill tab bar overlapping the card's bottom edge. Bar charts are drawn as fully-rounded capsules rather than rectangles.

style_signature: White-and-sage mobile UI where capsule-shaped bars in one highlighter yellow carry the entire chart, sitting under a lilac floating pill tab bar with a black circular centre button.

title: Aella Credit Dashboard - Credit Score SaaS
palette_note: Void-black stage around a mint-to-lilac washed near-white UI; status colour is candy — neon #84FC6C green, coral pink and yellow — dropped only as tiny capsule badges onto otherwise monochrome cards.

type.note: Uniformly light-weight and unusually small; the only scale jump is the dollar figures. Card titles sit in a slightly oblique lighter grade, which reads as a deliberate stylistic tic rather than emphasis.

imagery: 3D laptop render on black; iconography and a calendar-of-circles data graphic inside the UI

layout.note: Three-column card wall inside browser chrome plus a thin icon rail; cards are separated only by gaps and a pale mint-to-blue gradient wash, never by strokes. A honeycomb of circular day-cells is the compositional centrepiece.

style_signature: Pale mint-gradient-washed cards with no borders, tiny light type, and neon-green/coral candy capsule badges as the only colour, presented as a laptop render floating in pure black.

title: Ai Agent - Advanced filters for Saas dashboard table
palette_note: Warm-white page with a near-black pine-green #002424 nav rail and one emerald #20B070 brand mark; all remaining colour is strictly semantic — mint 'Yes' chips against blush 'No' chips.

type.note: Heavy 32px page title against 14px regular table rows — a big jump with nothing in between. Numeric columns are right-aligned tabular figures; chip labels drop to 12px medium.

imagery: iconography only, with third-party brand favicons acting as row markers

layout.note: Full-bleed table ruled with hairlines in both directions, tucked between a narrow dark icon rail and an overlaid right-hand AI drawer — the drawer is the only element casting a shadow, so it reads as physically above the page.

style_signature: Hairline-gridded white data table flanked by a near-black pine-green icon rail, with emerald/blush semantic chips and a shadowed AI copilot drawer floating over the right edge.

title: OptiSpace SaaS - Office Operating Dashboard
palette_note: Silver-on-silver monochrome where cards barely separate from the canvas, carrying a single burnt-orange-to-crimson ramp (#C07030 → #9C4824) that encodes every data value and the 3D massing model.

type.note: Distinctive oblique/italic set used for units and secondary values ('1 day/week', 'Data : Week', 'Per hour') against upright labels; large light numerals for headline metrics; a superscript-style dollar/m² treatment.

imagery: 3D isometric architectural renders — solid orange furniture inside a dashed wireframe shell

layout.note: Photographed at an extreme oblique angle so the UI runs off three edges; card boundaries are defined by a single tone step with no stroke; gauges are drawn as thin open arcs and time-series as dashed tick rows rather than filled shapes.

style_signature: Near-invisible silver-on-silver cards with thin-arc gauges and dashed tick charts, all values encoded in one orange-to-crimson ramp, over isometric dashed-wireframe architectural renders.

title: Zolatto – SaaS Marketing Analytics Dashboard
palette_note: Neutral grey stage and white app shell topped by a near-black #0C0C18 bar; a saturated periwinkle-indigo #6060FC pairs with soft mint #A8F0CC as the only two data hues, plus red/green semantic pills.

type.note: Currency figures at roughly 2.5x label size in a tight semibold; nav items regular; small tracked grey ALL-CAPS group headers ('MAIN', 'OTHER') are the only caps styling.

layout.note: Rounded app shell inset on the stage, with an unusually tall dark header band over a light sidebar plus 2x3 card grid. Charts sit inside pale capsule 'tracks' — every bar has a visible ghost container behind it.

style_signature: Rounded white app shell under a near-black header bar, with capsule-tracked bar charts in periwinkle-indigo and mint, hairline card borders and pastel semantic pills.

title: AirFreight SaaS - Aircraft Freight Dashboard
palette_note: Bone-cream UI washed with a pale sage-to-lilac vertical gradient on a flat grey set; black pills anchor everything and colour survives only as ~8px neon status dots — lime #CCFC00, magenta, cyan.

type.note: Near-uniform ~10px light labels across the whole screen with one light 40px title; four-letter airport codes set bold in caps are the only real weight jump, which makes them function as wayfinding.

imagery: 3D laptop render on a grey set, plus a 3D matte cargo-box object rendered inside the UI

layout.note: Cascading overlapped pill-cards fanned like a dealt deck across the top, over a three-panel body; forms use borderless fields on tinted capsules. Extreme perspective crop pushes the right third off-frame.

style_signature: Cream UI under a sage-to-lilac gradient wash, built from overlapping fanned pill-cards and borderless capsule form fields, with tiny neon-lime and magenta status dots as the only colour.

title: Lingaro - CO2 Emissions Distribution SaaS
palette_note: Dusty warm grey-pink UI on a two-tone grey/chartreuse set; the only saturated element is one magenta-to-crimson gradient insight card (#903060 → #D03030), answered by a lemon-yellow heatmap in the corner.

type.note: Wide geometric display title with an unusually open aperture, and a pronounced oblique/italic used for card titles and units throughout; ID codes ('Nº567891', 'C2-113') set in a tabular mono-feeling figure style.

imagery: no photography — the data is the imagery: white Sankey ribbons, hatched placeholder bars, a lemon heatmap grid

layout.note: Extreme-angle monitor photograph crops the UI hard on three sides; a full-width Sankey flow spans the upper half with thick black category rules; the toolbar is a row of borderless grey chips, and diagonal hatch fills stand in for empty data.

style_signature: Warm dusty grey-pink analytics canvas with white Sankey ribbons and diagonal-hatch placeholder bars, oblique geometric type, and exactly one magenta-to-crimson gradient card breaking the monochrome.

title: Dashboard for a Management SaaS ✦ Mytasky
palette_note: Near-black shell lit by a warm amber ambient bleed in the top-left corner; full-saturation pastel colour-blocks — violet #A890D8 and mint #B4E49C cards — sit against it, with one orange #E46030 bar cap as the alert note.

type.note: Heavy ~48px 'Welcome, Liam!' against a light 16px subhead — a very wide weight spread. One tracked ALL-CAPS pill button ('SET UP'); status pills in medium; table headers in light grey regular.

imagery: photography — a snow-capped mountain cropped into the mint colour-block card — plus emoji accents

layout.note: Cards notch into one another with inverted-corner cuts where edges meet, so the grid reads as a single die-cut sheet; rows are separated by dotted rules; a floating circular icon rail sits over the ambient glow; ample dark negative space up top.

style_signature: Near-black shell with a warm amber corner glow, hosting full-bleed pastel violet and mint colour-block cards that notch into each other with inverted-corner cuts and dotted row rules.

title: CreditTB - Credit SaaS Dashboard
palette_note: Pale mint-washed white with solid charcoal #242424 blocks; a highlighter-marker chartreuse #F0FC90 flags every changed value, checked task and score delta — and nothing else is coloured at all.

type.note: Oversized light-weight two-line headline that alternates black and mid-grey words for emphasis instead of changing weight; credit scores set very large and light with a small '/850' denominator trailing at label size.

imagery: line-art radial burst graphics and hatched chart fills; laptop photographed on a soft-focus set

layout.note: Two-panel split — mint hero over a white detail table; the sidebar is a 2-column grid of square icon tiles rather than a list; tabs overlap like folder edges; score gauges are open arcs with a dashed remainder track.

style_signature: Mint-washed dashboard where solid charcoal blocks and highlighter-chartreuse marker swipes are the only two accents, with light oversized numerals in open-arc gauges and folder-tab navigation.
